title: Legendary Burger
description: This datapack adds a burger that you can eat to get insane effects this mod is mainly made for burger smp but enyone can use it if they want!
body:
This Pack adds a burger to the game you also gotta turn on the resource pack before you play the pack was mainly for the server Burger smp but you can have it in your own world cuz it is fun.The burger adds these effects :
Absorption	X	10 minutes
Fire Resistance	I	7 minutes
Resistance	IV	5 minutes
Speed	II	5 minutes
Strength	II	5 minutes
Invisibility	I	3 minutes
i has a 30 second cooldown so it just gives it back and doesn t apply the effects if you eat it during the cooldown it makes the sound of the honey bottle if you drink it and gives a bottle but it instantly dissapears and doesn t effect the gameplay or the normal honey bottle. you can craft it in survival and i will show the picture of the recepie down below.When you try to craft it it will show a knowledge book but it will give you the burger when you put it in your inventory. You can give it to yourselfe using this command 
/function legendaryburger:give_burger
